description: This file defines the abstract class SystemTarget within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which serves as a base class for various system services like grain directory and reminder services. It manages message handling, timers, components, and lifecycle methods for system targets in the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: SystemTarget
classes.description: An abstract base class representing system services within Orleans, handling message processing, timers, extension components, and lifecycle management for system-level entities.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component of the specified type associated with the SystemTarget, or returns a default value if not found.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Associates a component instance with the specified type to the SystemTarget.

methods.name: HandleNewRequest
methods.description: Handles a new incoming message request by setting it as the current request and invoking runtime client handling.

methods.name: HandleResponse
methods.description: Handles a response message by updating internal state and notifying the runtime client.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, enqueues it for execution, or logs invalid messages.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Returns this instance cast to a specified target interface or type.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Method to activate the system target with given context—currently a no-op.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Method to deactivate the system target with a specified reason—currently a no-op.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Returns a completed task signaling the deactivation state—default is immediate completion.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, including stopping timers and decrementing system target counts.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Rehydrates the system target, default implementation disposes of the provided context if applicable.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Attempts migration; default implementation does nothing but is meant to support future migration logic.

methods.name: OnTimerCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new timer and adds it to the internal timer set.

methods.name: OnTimerDisposed
methods.description: Handles the disposal of a timer and removes it from the internal timer set.
